name: ARUNDO MAURITANICA
key_symptoms: Coldness in stomach. Longing for acids.
Itching; falling off of hair; roots of hair painful. Pustules. Pain in occiput, extends to right ciliary region. Deep seated pain in sides of head.
Dyspnœa; cough; bluish expectoration. Burning and pain in nipples.
Itching, burning; œdema of hands and feet. Burning and swelling of soles. Copious and offensive sweat of feet.
